notes.title: V1.4.5 "New UI" Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings from a nice new update of Mad Miner! In this update, I replaced the old interface designs with new ones!

Let me show you a comparison of the old and new designs.

This is an image from our main menu with old interface designs:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/c42472cdbc159ce0d194f014bf38148785a6b950.png
This is a view of our slightly modified main menu, featuring the revamped interface designs:

notes.title: V1.4.4 "Tutorial" Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings from a new update of Mad Miner!

Even though I'm calling this update a “tutorial” update, you might remember that Mad Miner already has a tutorial. So why is this update called “tutorial”?

Because... With this update, Mad Miner now has a much more polished tutorial that new players will love!

The old tutorial map was a rather boring shade of gray and not something we would want to play with. But now we have a new tutorial map with more vibrant colors and more readable text!

Let me show you the difference with the images below:

This is a frame from our old and boring tutorial map.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/5681e5f8d1a37e0b1a4f729b2f77c349f2e29c6b.png

This is our completely revamped tutorial map with new narratives!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/b93d8c6e44371f65e354a234fe3472f0ca1f3855.png

Ahh... This new map is really warming me up...

I hope the new tutorial map will help you get into the game faster and enjoy the unique world of Mad Miner!

There are also a few fixes and additions with this update:

The ESC menu differences on different maps were ugly and this has been made as pleasant as possible.
The number indicators for block selections in the terrain editor, which I don't even remember why they exist, have been removed.
In previous updates, I included the unique interfaces of each crafting table, including the indicators of the graves that appear when we die, but I realized that I didn't include the new version I drew in the updates... 😅. Anyway, it's now included!
Added zooming in on your character when you press the R key. Maybe it was a feature I added in case I shoot a video, but I think it will be useful for you too.

Thank you for playing Mad Miner or adding it to your wishlist!

notes.title: V1.4.3 Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings from a new update of Mad Miner!

With this update, 15 new game soundtracks join the Mad Miner soundtrack to enhance your gaming experience. Mad Miner's OST now includes 25 different tracks!

Also, the game soundtrack will now play continuously! If you get bored of them, don't forget to turn down the volume.

These 15 new tracks are a gift to Mad Miner from the canceled Mad Miner 2. His grandfather is very proud of him...

notes.title: V1.4.2 "Shelter" Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings from another update of Mad Miner!

I realize that this update is not as big as the 1.4.1 update, but I still like to provide updates like this to show my support for the game.

All right! Let me tell you what happened in this update:

With this update, the interior design of our starter shelter has changed a lot!
Wooden walls have been added.
Wooden floors have been added.
Iron lanterns have been replaced with wooden lanterns and their positions have been rearranged.
The positions of the crafting and material tables were moved upwards and wooden bridges were added underneath them. Also stairs that allow us to access them!
2 crop baskets will now accompany us so that we can plant seeds as soon as we get them from the ground!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/f85eea7dd966add275250df30ebad5d05b0792ff.png

Thank you for playing, browsing or adding Mad Miner to your wishlist!

notes.title: V1.4.1 "Eggs" Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Mad Miner players and fans! Thank you again and again for your interest in Mad Miner.

I realize this isn't a big update, but I wanted to remind you that I haven't forgotten my game I wanted to emphasize that this is an important update to show that I can still support Mad Miner.

So what has been added in this update?

Eggs! There are now 3 animal eggs that you can access with the builder mode. Using these eggs you can create: moles, golden moles or bats in the locations you want. I honestly don't know what this will do for you, but I wanted us Mad Miner players to have this possibility. You can actually squeeze them into the places you want in your mines or use them for your custom maps.

Which bugs have been fixed?

Fixed some visual bugs in the terrain editor.
Bats could hover when flying in water or oil, but this has now been fixed.
Enemies no longer spawn near our character when he first enters a mine (default mine or discovered mines). You are safe!
Fixed a sorting bug related to item mods.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/d7f46304e8ce9a1a5be6be24a38e22055518e519.png

notes.title: V1.4 "Details" Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone from another big update of Mad Miner!

In this update, I focused on small details and made some visual and technical changes and added innovations.

Let's quickly examine what has been added and changed in this version:


Smokes added to the furnaces and crop machine.
Operating sound added to the engine and machines.
Added character coughing when approaching the engine.
Alternative new appearance added to the chests.
Climbing vines added.
Heart beating animation added when the heart bars reach their final stage.
Inventory performance improved.
The last selection of the quick access bar is now saved.
The drawings of all bars have been improved and their positions arranged.
Our ground floor in the mines we travel to has been increased from 16 to 8.
The 3rd stage of potatoes in the crop basket has been reduced.
Hook swing speed increased.
Engine smoke increased.
The bug where bats slept inside walls fixed.
Warning animation error of heart bars fixed.


Thank you for playing and continuing to play Mad Miner.

notes.title: V1.3 PVE Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings from Mad Miner's 3rd major update!

As you know, Mad Miner has been an enemy-free game since its release. I changed this decision with a poll I asked you all to take, and then I got to work to bring you the PVE update.

Here is the PVE update and the new features that come with it!

What Has Been Added?

Enemies wielding pistols or shotguns and spreading chaos. They also drop loot when you kill them.
Pistols and shotguns.
Gunsmith's table.
Bat meat and soup.
Damage increase upgrade.

What Has Changed?

The carrot drawing has been made a little more orange.
Wall shadows have been made more minimal.

What Has Been Fixed?

Fixed the color problems of the new colored indicators.
Fixed the problem of the engine (item) not working off-screen.
And some minor bugs have been fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/b6c9284c61913fea0141a6aad140c1ed37ba3b4d.png

notes.title: Should the PVE Update Come?
notes.notes:
Hello Mad Miner players or followers!

As you know, there are no enemies in Mad Miner. We rely on our hunger, thirst or oxygen to survive. These 3 vital factors keep us busy enough.

My question for you is: Should enemies be added to our mines to add action to Mad Miner? 

You decide this update. If you approve it, it will be added, if you don't approve it, it won't be added.

You can participate in the voting here. Thank you in advance for your time.

notes.title: Item Modding Update!
notes.notes:
Mad Miner's Second Major Update is Live!

Now you can design your own visual items, add animations and set recipes to craft in the fight for survival!

notes.title: V1.1 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone from Mad Miner's first major update!

Thank you for playing Mad Miner or adding it to your wishlist. This interest greatly influences my motivation to develop Mad Miner. It makes me very happy to see people interested in my game. I hope Mad Miner is a game that deserves your playing time.

Without further ado, I would like to explain step by step what awaits you in this big update.

If you're ready, sit back, fasten your seatbelts and hold on tight!

Major Updates:

Our mines are now accompanied by water! For this reason, a third vital factor comes into play and we start to feel thirsty. Thanks to water, we produce water pots, water our crops, fish and make our soils to muddy.
A total of 20 new buildings, 5 new buildings in each mine, are being added to our mines. These structures sometimes reward us, sometimes make us think, and sometimes just sit there. But it greatly increases our sense of discovery!
With the new inventory layout, we can access our items under categories. In this way, we stop getting lost among hundreds of items.
We will now be able to produce our items with a single click! You remember that we need to place three different materials to craft items on the crafting table. Instead of sending those materials to the production table one by one, they will be placed automatically when you click on the item you want to produce with the "right mouse button". This way you won't have to memorize the recipes!
From now on, your lives will come into play when you run out of any vital factor (thirsty, lack of oxygen or hunger). In this way, you will avoid dying suddenly, and if you want, you will be able to delay it further thanks to the "health increase" development.
Mad Miner's food is taking a radical change for the first time. While before you could not consume food other than canned foods, now you will be able to drink soups. For this reason, while soups will be your meals that you consume at an earlier time, canned foods will be a more difficult to produce and more filling meal option. In addition, the canning machine for canned food should produce empty cans; For soups, you must produce empty plates at the ingredient table.
I told you that a new character would join us. Gamblers now accompany us in the deserts. Thanks to this NPC, we will be able to spin a wheel with four different prizes at the same time in exchange for 1 shiny gold bar. The rewards he gives are not bad!


And I list the others in short bullet points:


Bat.
Seed Production Table.
Fishing Rods and Fisherman's Table.
Fish Soup and Canned Fish.
10 new soundtracks designed entirely for Mad Miner. These music were created by Nervio Music.
4 new building blocks available from the Patcher Box.
Soil, Mud, Empty Pot and Empty Flowerpot.
Potter's Table.
Wild crops.
Binoculars.
Wall Candle and Torch.
Traders following us.
Ability to swim in water and petroleum.
New clothes for our character.
Stone Ladder.
Wooden, stone and iron doors.
Rope Bridge.
4 new statues obtainable through mine ladders.
Change the intensity of shadows thanks to a new setting.
Smoke effect when item is placed.
Details added to the character when oxygen resistance and hunger resistance improvements are completed.


Minor features changed/added with this version:


The elevator drawing has changed.
The design of the information box showing the purchased items has been changed.
The color of the box showing item descriptions has changed.
The production of the oxygen machine and tube has changed.
Added fire sound to lanterns and torches.
Tutorial made a little more detailed.
Furnaces have been added to be returned to the inventory when broken.
The satiety rates of canned food have been increased.
The production of canned foods with special effects has been made easier.
Added diary to be open at startup.
Additional information showing in which mode the saved mines in the record loading menu are recorded.
The storage limit for pickaxes has been removed.
Dynamite destroys everything now.
Some floor designs have been redrawn.
The boxes of all interacted items have been redesign.


Bugs fixed with this version:


When put into Builder mode, unfinished upgrades were locked as if they were completed when you loaded your saved mine.
The game would open and close again when the language was changed.
Some buildings did not destroy the walls behind them. For this reason, the wall shadows were disappearing.
When tables that were not crafting or material tables were broken, they were returned to the inventory as production or material tables.
Ladders were not spawn in mining cities.
Rail line formations coincided with mining cities.
And many minor bugs have been fixed.


And some images:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/e5178a97b24841efe4e4ca041652895a538f4f27.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/126b6c1931a5ac8130ed1c89ee54ac7746e54afd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/91a6308023d5205bce1d1dab1a4a900596097294.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/beaf08d0a3b96bd517b04d0f040df6508f853071.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/3768cffd5fd443334adb58c13fbd79a5462ec136.png

I hope you have an even better time with the V1.1 update. I will rest a little and follow your comments. Please let me know your feedback on our Discord server or by writing a review.

Also, I would like to thanks EAF156thTFWAS, who is a Mad Miner player and has rewritten the Japanese translation.

Have fun playing, lots of digging!

-Samet

notes.title: V1.1 UPDATE PLAN
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/219b0944b84686444aaa05bef19cf10e1a6164a7.png

I hope you enjoy playing Mad Miner. Because with the V1.1 update, some innovations that will double your enjoyment are under development to be included in the game.

If Mad Miner continues to receive the necessary attention; I will be adding new updates to the game to make it more advanced and more enjoyable.

One of the next big updates is V1.1!

Let's take a look at what this update promises:


A third survival challenge will be added thanks to a new resource.
Significant things will be achieved thanks to some new tables.
It will be getting harder to fill our stomach.
Cultivating crops will become a little more detailed.
Although our struggle for life is getting harder in general, dying will not be as easy and simple as it used to be.
A new animal will accompany us in our mines.
New structures will accompany the mines that we are currently able to go to.
A new NPC will join our mines.
Some NPCs will can now move around and roam in mines.
Polishing will be done to increase the player experience.

I hope this list has sparked your excitement and further increased your interest in Mad Miner.

I wish you good luck in the mines while I work on the update.

-Samet
